title: Narrowing happens in a modal that writes what it did

criteria.text: Only the panel-opening control on the results surface; no chips or pills
criteria.note: `ActiveFilterChips` and `KindFilterPills` were deleted in #174; `BrowseSurface.tsx` renders the search row (one filter-open control, the place pill, the List/Map switch) and the dock; no chip or pill row [V]. No guard asserts it (#624). Reviewed no (#174 no `Reviewed by:`). Shipped: deploy-health green on 9dde664f. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Apply closes the panel and writes the selection into the box as readable, retypable text
criteria.note: #750: the sheet closes and the box reads e.g. 'coffee this weekend', plain lowercase words, no hashtag; typed words are kept in front (PM, 2026-10-11) [V]. Checked: `[guards F092.2]` in `BrowseSurface.test.tsx` plus `box-text.test.ts` (partial); PR says red before green. Reviewed no (#750 `review-skipped`). Shipped: green on c16c86a7. #619 closed by #750. Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Results match the box text, panel-written or typed
criteria.note: #750 delivers it: `readBox` takes the schedule, tags and 'updates' out of the box and the rest is the free search; no second filter state (`BrowseSurface.tsx`) [V]. Checked: tests exist ('typing the same words by hand does the same') but no marker claims F092.3 (#830). Reviewed no (#750 `review-skipped`). Shipped: green on c16c86a7. #620 is stale (built by #750). Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Every string the panel can write is understood by the box reader
criteria.note: One grammar read both ways in `box-text.ts` (#750) [V]. Checked: `[guards F092.4]` in `box-text.test.ts`, a round trip over every schedule and tag subset (3 x 2^8 selections), seen red first per the PR. Reviewed no (#750 `review-skipped`). Shipped: green on c16c86a7. #621 stays open though #750 built it (the PR's 'Closes #619, #621' closed only #619). Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: Text not understood opens the panel; never errors, never silently empties
criteria.note: Free text never errors: unknown words stay as the free search (`readBox`) [V]. Nothing opens the sheet on text it does not understand; an empty result reads 'Nothing here yet — try another filter' with Clear filters. Replaces #57's chips fallback. Issue #622.

criteria.text: Clearing the box clears the narrowing
criteria.note: The box is the only state, so emptying it clears schedule, tags and updates (`BrowseSurface.tsx`; the search bar's close also clears) [V]. Checked: 'clearing the box clears the narrowing' in `BrowseSurface.test.tsx` is unmarked (#830). Reviewed no (#750 `review-skipped`). Shipped: green on c16c86a7. #623 is stale (built by #750). Smoked: smoke-live 2026-10-15 (24891b7) and 2026-10-16 (7f38b45) were green and opened /explore signed out and as members; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].
